title: API Error (Internet connection is unreliable)
body:
**Bug Description**
I am unable to use Claude Code since this morning. Any prompt returns the following error (10 attempts), then aborts the request:

API Error (Internet connection is unreliable)

All other internet services are working correctly from my workstation, including Copilot and the Jetbrains AI assistant.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: gnome-terminal
- Version: 1.0.120

top_comments.author: viper7882
top_comments.body: My experience is that when Claude fixed [Claude App and API connectivity errors](https://status.anthropic.com/incidents/xg2v4m4nc40n), certain users are required to re-anthentic their account but the API error didn't prompt that. The workaround is to run `claude /login`

top_comments.author: amoilanen
top_comments.body:
`claude /login` did not help in my case. The Web browser page is opened, I see

> Build something great
You’re all set up for Claude Code.
You can now close this window.

Claude Code though outputs an error:

> /login
 OAuth error: 
 Press Enter to retry.

top_comments.author: kdkoala
top_comments.body:
Did you figure this out? I have one user that is getting a similar issue today, but it could be related to our zero-trust client (Zscaler):

> Unable to connect to API due to poor internet connection
